text: The Patriots' 35-6 blowout loss to the Jaguars on Sunday has sparked serious questions about how the offense is being deployed, with Drake Maye himself calling the unit's performance "unacceptable" after committing three turnovers—two interceptions and a lost fumble—that underscore his early-season struggles. Film breakdowns from beat writers have examined what went wrong in Jacksonville, including defensive coverage splits and offensive execution issues, while analysis pieces explore whether the Patriots are actually using Maye the right way in their current scheme. Mike Vrabel addressed the loss at his Monday press conference, and the defensive bright spot came courtesy of Marcus Jones, who notched his first interception of the season, but that lone positive couldn't offset Lawrence's three touchdown passes for Jacksonville or the lopsided nature of the defeat that raises mounting concerns about both Maye's play and the offensive system surrounding him.
